runtime_speed_stability_formula: v7-egress-stability: stability = floor_p10_mbps / avg_mbps over last 30 nonzero speed history samples
eligibility_formula: v7-users-autoswitch: if live egress.stability < min_stability and 1h history stability < min_stability, block stability_below_floor unless evidence exception applies
service_score_formula_scope: service suitability uses service-matrix reachability/latency/content status for required/profile services; it does not measure speed variance floor/avg directly
